title: Check Hospital HMI Operations Screen Induct/Extract Position Read-Only Data and WCS Status Messages
summary: Use the Hospital HMI / lane UI Operations Menu screen to read the WCS-fed induct and extract position fields (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status). Confirm the Status messages explain why the tote is there and what station operator menu/action to use.
when_to_use: When a tote arrives at the hospital station and you need to determine what tote/AGV is at the induct and extract positions and what the WCS status message requires the station operator to do next.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the Hospital HMI / lane UI and read the read-only Induct Position and Extract Position fields and their WCS Status messages.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI / lane UI (Hospital station Operations Menu screen)

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI Operations Menu screen showing read-only Induct Position and Extract Position panels (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status).

steps.title: Open Hospital HMI Operations Menu and locate Induct Position / Extract Position sections
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that displays the WCS-fed, read-only induct and extract position information for the hospital station.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI / lane UI, navigate to the Operations Menu screen that contains the "Induct Position" and "Extract Position" sections.
steps.expected_result: The screen shows both "Induct Position" and "Extract Position" sections.
steps.healthy_condition: "Induct Position" and "Extract Position" sections are visible on the Operations Menu screen.
steps.failure_condition: The Operations Menu screen is not showing the "Induct Position" and/or "Extract Position" sections.

actions.label: Navigate to Operations Menu
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI and navigate to the Operations Menu screen that contains the "Induct Position" and "Extract Position" sections.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 4.1.3.2: OPERATIONS MENU. The "Induct Position" and "Extract Position" information on this screen is read-only and received from the WCS.

steps.title: Read Induct Position read-only fields (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status)
steps.purpose: Capture the WCS-fed induct position identity and the WCS Status message that guides the station operator action/menu.
steps.instruction: In the "Induct Position" section, read the four read-only fields: AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.
steps.expected_result: The "Induct Position" section displays values for AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and a Status message.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status are present in the "Induct Position" section as read-only WCS data.
steps.failure_condition: The "Induct Position" Status field is blank/missing or does not provide a WCS status message explaining why the tote is there and what menu/action the station operator needs.

actions.label: Read Induct Position fields
actions.exact_action: In the "Induct Position" section, read the four read-only fields: AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.

stop_or_escalate_if: Induct Position Status does not provide explanation/action guidance (why the tote is there and what menu/action to use).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-30: Hospital HMI Operations Screen. Induct Position: AGV# (ID number of the AGV at the induct side), Tote ID (ID number of the tote at the induct side), Bar Code (information received from the tote bar code), Status (a status message received from the WCS about the tote).
The status messages will tell the station operator why the tote is there and what menu they need to use and what action they need to perform.

steps.title: Read Extract Position read-only fields (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status)
steps.purpose: Capture the WCS-fed extract position identity and the WCS Status message that guides the station operator action/menu.
steps.instruction: In the "Extract Position" section, read the four read-only fields: AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.
steps.expected_result: The "Extract Position" section displays values for AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and a Status message.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status are present in the "Extract Position" section as read-only WCS data.
steps.failure_condition: The "Extract Position" Status field is blank/missing or does not provide a WCS status message explaining why the tote is there and what menu/action the station operator needs.

actions.label: Read Extract Position fields
actions.exact_action: In the "Extract Position" section, read the four read-only fields: AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.

stop_or_escalate_if: Extract Position Status does not provide explanation/action guidance (why the tote is there and what menu/action to use).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-30: Hospital HMI Operations Screen. Extract Position: AGV# (ID number of the AGV at the extract side), Tote ID (ID number of the tote at the extract side), Bar Code (information received from the tote bar code), Status (a status message received from the WCS about the tote).
The status messages will tell the station operator why the tote is there and what menu they need to use and what action they need to perform.

steps.title: Confirm both Status messages are present and provide WCS explanation/action guidance
steps.purpose: Ensure the WCS Status messages on both induct and extract positions are usable for station operator decision-making.
steps.instruction: Verify that the "Induct Position" Status and "Extract Position" Status messages are present and written as messages received from the WCS that explain why the tote is there and what menu/action the station operator needs to use.
steps.expected_result: Both Status fields contain non-blank WCS messages that provide explanation and action/menu guidance.
steps.healthy_condition: Induct Position Status and Extract Position Status each provide a clear WCS message describing why the tote is there and what menu/action to perform.
steps.failure_condition: Either Status field is blank/missing or does not provide explanation/action guidance.

actions.label: Validate Status message content
actions.exact_action: Confirm the "Induct Position" and "Extract Position" Status messages are present and are written as messages received from the WCS (i.e., they explain why the tote is there and what menu/action the station operator needs).

stop_or_escalate_if: Induct Position Status is missing/blank or lacks explanation/action guidance.
Extract Position Status is missing/blank or lacks explanation/action guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The "Induct Position" and "Extract Position" information on this screen is read-only and received from the WCS. The status messages will tell the station operator why the tote is there and what menu they need to use and what action they need to perform.

success_criteria: Induct Position shows read-only AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and a non-blank Status message.
Extract Position shows read-only AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and a non-blank Status message.
Both Status messages explain why the tote is there and what menu/action the station operator needs to use.
healthy_conditions: Induct Position Status is present and provides WCS explanation/action guidance.
Extract Position Status is present and provides WCS explanation/action guidance.
failure_conditions: Either Status message does not provide explanation/action guidance (why the tote is there and what menu/action to use).
escalation_guidance: If either position’s Status message is missing/blank or does not provide explanation/action guidance, stop and escalate for support.
